name: X01_euler
notes: Downgrade solver: heun->euler. Euler O(h^2) vs Heun O(h^3). Predict: -0.005 CLIP-S, +0.01 LPIPS.

name: X02_rk4
notes: Upgrade solver: heun->rk4 (4th order). Extreme high-order. Predict: marginal gain (saturates, see 4I.2b notes).

name: X03_steps_1
notes: Extreme: 1-step inference. Tests if model can do single-step style transfer. Predict: -0.02 CLIP-S, big LPIPS degradation.

name: X04_steps_32
notes: Extreme: 32-step inference. Diminishing returns test. Predict: +0.001 CLIP-S vs 8-step, 4x slower.

name: X05_corrector_4
notes: Heavy corrector: 4 corrector steps. Predict: marginal quality gain, 4x slower per step.

name: X06_no_spectral_ode
notes: DESTRUCTIVE: disable spectral_ode entirely. Predict: large degradation, validates DWT necessity.

name: X07_spectral_levels_4
notes: Extreme deep: 4-level DWT (vs SOTA 1). LL_4 (2x2) near-global. Predict: over-decomposition, structural loss.

name: X08_spectral_levels_5
notes: EXTREME: 5-level DWT. LL_5 (1x1) = scalar. Predict: catastrophic, validates 3-level peak.

name: X09_lowpass_avg
notes: Replace DWT with avg_pool. Loses frequency localization. Predict: -0.01 CLIP-S.

name: X10_w_ll_0
notes: Zero LL weight: ignore low-freq. Predict: content collapse, LPIPS explosion.

name: X11_w_hh_3x
notes: 3x HH weight: extreme high-freq emphasis. Predict: texture over-emphasis, content loss.

name: X12_adain_0
notes: DESTRUCTIVE: AdaIN scale=0. No style injection at endpoint. Predict: clip near identity (0.6933).

name: X13_adain_4x
notes: EXTREME: AdaIN scale=4.0 (5x SOTA). Predict: style explosion, content collapse.

name: X14_adain_every_step
notes: Apply AdaIN every step (vs only_last_step=True). Predict: alpha invalidated (4G.2b lesson).

name: X15_lowpass_1
notes: Shallow: 1-level lowpass (vs 3). Predict: less structural protection, +0.005 LPIPS.

name: X16_lowpass_5
notes: EXTREME deep: 5-level lowpass. Predict: over-smoothing, structural blur.

name: X17_velocity_floor_0
notes: Remove velocity floor. Predict: small velocity at endpoints causes noise.

name: X18_velocity_floor_0p3
notes: EXTREME high velocity floor=0.3. Predict: forced large velocity, instability.

name: X19_path_linear
notes: Linear path (vs tri_band). Predict: loses frequency-aware interpolation, -0.005 CLIP-S.

name: X20_path_slerp
notes: Spherical linear interpolation. Predict: norm-preserving but may mismatch latent geometry.

name: X21_sigma_0
notes: DESTRUCTIVE: zero bridge noise. Deterministic path. Predict: overfitting, reduced diversity.

name: X22_sigma_0p5
notes: EXTREME: 25x bridge noise. Predict: trajectory collapses, near-pure-noise.

name: X23_no_target_proj
notes: Disable DWT target projection. Predict: high-freq leakage into training target.

name: X24_hungarian
notes: Optimal OT: Hungarian (vs independent). Predict: better pairings, slower, marginal CLIP-S gain.

name: X25_no_structure_cost
notes: DESTRUCTIVE: zero structure cost. Predict: random pairings, large LPIPS increase.

name: X26_structure_5x
notes: 5x structure cost. Predict: overly conservative pairings, reduced style diversity.

name: X27_sinkhorn_eps_0p5
notes: EXTREME blurry OT: epsilon=0.5. Predict: near-uniform coupling, style mixing.

name: X28_sinkhorn_iters_10
notes: Low-quality OT: 10 iters (vs 60). Predict: under-converged coupling, minor degradation.

name: X29_no_content_loss
notes: DESTRUCTIVE: zero content loss. Predict: content collapse, LPIPS explosion.

name: X30_content_5x
notes: 5x content weight. Predict: content-preserved but style-weak, CLIP-S drops.

name: X31_no_style_loss
notes: DESTRUCTIVE: zero style loss. Predict: no style transfer, clip=identity.

name: X32_style_32x
notes: EXTREME: 32x style weight (4x SOTA). Predict: style explosion, content collapse.

name: X33_style_64x
notes: EXTREME: 64x style weight (8x SOTA). Predict: catastrophic content loss.

name: X34_no_flow
notes: DESTRUCTIVE: zero flow loss. Predict: model cannot learn trajectory, NaN/instability.

name: X35_no_kinetic
notes: Zero kinetic loss. Predict: less smooth trajectories, marginal effect.

name: X36_attn_softmax
notes: Softmax attention (vs relu2). Historical bug comparison (4I.2a fixed relu2). Predict: -0.005.

name: X37_heads_1
notes: Minimal: 1 attention head. Predict: reduced style capacity, -0.005 CLIP-S.

name: X38_heads_16
notes: EXTREME: 16 attention heads (4x SOTA). Predict: over-parameterized, possible overfit.

name: X39_no_shortcut
notes: Zero style shortcut. Predict: loses residual style path, -0.01 CLIP-S.

name: X40_extrap_1
notes: EXTREME: extrap_alpha=1.0 (10x SOTA). Predict: extrapolation instability.

name: X41_dim_32
notes: Half capacity: base_dim=32. Predict: under-fit, -0.01 both metrics.

name: X42_dim_128
notes: 2x capacity: base_dim=128. Predict: over-parameterized, may overfit, slower.

name: X43_res_blocks_2
notes: Shallow: 2 res blocks (vs 4). Predict: reduced capacity, -0.005 CLIP-S.

name: X44_no_skip
notes: No skip fusion. Predict: loses multi-scale fusion, content loss.

name: X45_epochs_1
notes: Minimal: 1 epoch. Predict: under-trained, large degradation.

name: X46_lr_10x
notes: EXTREME: 10x learning rate. Predict: divergence/instability.

name: X47_lr_0p1x
notes: EXTREME: 1/10 learning rate. Predict: under-trained, slow convergence.

name: X48_t_uniform
notes: Uniform t sampling (vs logit_normal). Predict: less focus on mid-trajectory, marginal.
